name: Kura Wine
description: Kura Wine — a WooCommerce store theme for an independent wine merchant. A dark slate-ink ground with a quiet umber wash, Fraunces and Karla. The home page opens on a full-bleed film photograph that slowly zooms and cross-fades through three slides under a transparent header, then a scattered About, shipments with vertical region titles, the bottles beside a large photograph, a half-bleed split with hairline link rows, the Friday table and an umber photo band. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; motion respects reduced-motion.
